# Spandidos Publications

> A leading academic publisher specializing in peer-reviewed oncology, molecular medicine, and biomedical research journals with rigorous editorial standards and global indexing.

Spandidos Publications maintains a portfolio of high-impact journals including Oncology Letters, International Journal of Oncology, and Molecular and Clinical Oncology. The publisher is committed to advancing scientific knowledge through quality peer review, transparent editorial policies, and comprehensive indexing across major academic databases.

## Key Topics

- Oncology Letters
- International Journal of Oncology

## Oncology Letters Journal

- [Oncology Letters Homepage](https://www.spandidos-publications.com/ol): Primary journal for experimental and clinical oncology research
- [Author Guidelines for Oncology Letters](https://www.spandidos-publications.com/pages/ol/info_for_authors): Comprehensive submission instructions and manuscript preparation guidelines
- [Oncology Letters Aims and Scope](https://www.spandidos-publications.com/pages/ol/aims_scope): Journal focus areas, research scope, and publication priorities
- [Oncology Letters Editorial Policies](https://www.spandidos-publications.com/pages/ol/editorialPol): Peer review process, publication standards, and editorial guidelines
- [Oncology Letters Editorial Board](https://www.spandidos-publications.com/pages/ol/editorial): Editorial team members and journal management structure
- [Oncology Letters Indexing](https://www.spandidos-publications.com/pages/ol/abstracting): Abstracting and indexing services covering the journal
- [Oncology Letters Archive](https://www.spandidos-publications.com/ol/archive): Access to published articles and past issues
